narrative.details: I'm going to see about making plans to return home soon. Hopefully, Stephanie is doing well back in Stormwind. I can't wait to see her again. Till next we meet, champion.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
So, you've returned so quickly, huh? And what pray tell have you accomplished in your time away from here?

Were you able to help a noble cause? Perhaps you've learned the value of charity or some more about your obligations to the citizens of Azeroth. Tell me, who have you helped and how.... Impressive, adventurer, those are surely the actions of one who follows the Light.

Such sacrifice will always be rewarded in time.
